resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because de-duplication returned candidates, all of them belonging to the resident's own parent Aadhaar, while the applicant was not whitelisted.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is processed as a fresh enrolment and therefore expects no de-duplication candidates at all. Matches were returned and, although every one came from the resident's own parent Aadhaar rather than a different identity, the packet carried no whitelisting to permit them and was rejected. Whitelisting the applicant allows the packet to be reprocessed against the same candidates.
